The two 2027 rows are from the Gundam media table (rev 2026-11-09): SEED Freedom Zero | Movie | 2027 | Cosmic Era (CE) 74, and RG: XARX-ZERO | TV series | 2027 | After Apocalypse (AA) 45; the SEED Freedom article (rev 2026-11-07) calls Zero a prequel.
